# Quick-view logo assets

- `rockmy-logo.png` and `cartpool-logo.png`: user-supplied logos, background removed with the built-in image editing tool. Prompt: remove only the white outer background outside the circular logo, output genuine transparent alpha, retain the interior artwork, lettering, colours and proportions. Original uploads are untouched. Generated versions should be checked against brand masters before publication.
- `TikTok-logo-RGB-Horizontal-black.png`: official TikTok developer logo pack, https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/getting-started-design-guidelines and https://sf16-va.tiktokcdn.com/obj/eden-va2/uvzhqeh7nuhd/tt4d/logo-pack.zip . This is the TikTok corporate logo, with a separate TikTok Shop caption in the UI.
- `shopee-logo.svg`: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shopee.svg ; file https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/fe/Shopee.svg . Listed as PD-textlogo; trademark rights remain with the owner.
- `foodpanda-logo.svg`: Simple Icons brand icon, https://cdn.simpleicons.org/foodpanda/E21B70 . Official media-kit download was unavailable in this session.
- `nus-logo.svg`: https://worldvectorlogo.com/logo/nus ; file https://cdn.worldvectorlogo.com/logos/nus.svg . Official identity reference: https://www.nus.edu.sg/identity/guidelines/logo-guideline .

Brand marks identify the portfolio owner's stated experience or education, not sponsorship or endorsement. This is a local, unpublished preview. Public availability of assets does not grant brand-use permission; check applicable brand requirements before publishing, particularly NUS and TikTok, whose identity pages require permission.
